## 2026-11-24 — v0.67.3

### Fixed

- **`tests/claude_hook_destinations_test.sh` no longer fails under CPU load.** Its two latency checks wanted the hook to finish in under 2000 ms, and a busy machine missed that on `main` too. They now count the shell commands the hook and its child scripts run (an xtrace on `BASH_XTRACEFD`): a hit must run the same number against 5,000 names as against 10, and an out-of-scope call must also never reach `private_name_candidate` or `check_private_names.sh`. A per-name loop in `check_private_names.sh` or a name scan before the scope decision fails it (both checked by reverting locally). bash older than 4.1 skips the count.
- **Ctrl-C leaves no temp directory behind.** An interrupt during `fetch_verified_gpg_key` or the Node.js step of `deps` left a 0700 directory in `TMPDIR`: the INT/TERM helper in `lib/fetch.sh` kept one path in a global, so `fetch_to_file` inside it replaced the outer registration. The new `lib/trap_stack.sh` (`trap_stack_push <path>`, `trap_stack_pop [--keep]`) keeps a stack: every registered path is removed on `EXIT`, `HUP`, `INT` and `TERM`, newest first, then the caller's own trap runs, or the shell exits 129, 130 or 143. The caller's traps are put back after the last pop, an ignored signal stays ignored, and a subshell never removes its parent's paths. Registered now: `fetch_to_file` (the partial file), `fetch_verified_gpg_key`, the `deps` Node.js directory, `gitleaks_install`, `foxguard_install`, `ollama_install`, the three `docker_install` directories, `docs_site_check`, the chunk directory of `screencap_record`, the keystore `android_sign` decodes, `resolve_wp_tag` in `scripts/ci_wp_phpunit.sh`, and the stage and probe directories of `scripts/setup-hooks.sh`. `scripts/build_brew_tarball.sh` and `scripts/build_rpm_artifacts.sh` get an `EXIT` trap. PowerShell: the chunk directory of `screencap_record` is removed in a `finally`. The mount point of the macOS Docker Desktop download is registered with `trap_stack_push --run`: it is detached (`hdiutil detach`, then `-force`) before it is removed, and a directory still mounted is never removed. A path is removed once: the `EXIT` trap after a signal, or a signal during the removal itself, does not run it again. `--run` takes only a shell function defined at the push (exit 2 otherwise); in a trap it runs in a subshell, so one that calls `exit` does not skip the older paths. bash 3.2, in a subshell: a trap the subshell set itself before the first push is not chained (see `docs/modules/trap_stack.md`). Tests: `tests/trap_stack_test.sh` sends INT, TERM and HUP to a script that registers two directories, one inside the other, and to `fetch_verified_gpg_key`, `_deps_install_node_linux` and `gitleaks_install` mid-download, and a `--run` path on INT and pop; `tests/docker_install_test.sh` checks detach before removal on a failed install and on TERM, and that the mount dir is kept when detach fails; `tests/setup_claude_hook_test.sh` checks the no-`lib/` fallback of `setup-hooks.sh`; `ps/tests/screencap_test.ps1` (both fail without the fix). Closes https://github.com/nikolareljin/script-helpers/issues/296.
- **`ci_wp_plugin_check.sh` and `ci_pimcore_bundle_check.sh` no longer hand `sh -lc` to containers.** Their nine `docker_compose run|exec ... sh -lc` calls now use `sh -c`; a login shell sources `/etc/profile`, which can replace the image `PATH`. `tests/ci_docker_shell_test.sh` matched only `bash -lc` and only `docker run`/`DOCKER` lines, so it missed them; it now matches `bash` or `sh` as a whole word (bare, quoted or `/bin/sh`, not `zsh`) and also reads `docker_compose`, `docker compose` and `docker exec` lines. It catches a login shell in any flag form (`-l -c`, `--login -c`, `-cl`, `-lic`, `-o pipefail -lc`), not only `-lc`, follows a multi-line array literal opened on a docker line until the `)` that balances it, and reads `docker container run|exec`; `sh -c 'ls -l'` is not a hit. The scanner is checked against 38 labelled samples. Measured on `wordpress:cli`, `pimcore/pimcore:php8.2-latest` and `php8.3-latest`: `PATH` and the location of `wp`, `composer` and `php` are the same under `-c` and `-lc`. Test: `tests/ci_docker_shell_test.sh` (fails without the fix). Closes https://github.com/nikolareljin/script-helpers/issues/87.
- **`preflight.sh` detects a shell repository.** A root `Makefile` (or `makefile`, `GNUmakefile`) with a `test` target and no other stack anywhere is the new `make` stack, and runs `make -C <root> test`. Before, `preflight --quick` exited 3 ("no stack detected") in such a repo, script-helpers included, so the pre-push hook ran none of its own tests through preflight. A repository with any other stack, at the root or nested, is checked as before. `--stack make` and `make .` in `.preflight` work too, beside another stack (`--stack make --stack node` runs both). `--list` and `-List` now print what `--stack`/`-Stack` selects rather than every detected project. `ps/scripts/preflight.ps1` does the same (`-Stack make`); `-Stack make,node` no longer drops `node`. An assignment such as `test ::= x` is not a test target. Tests: `tests/preflight_make_test.sh` and `ps/tests/preflight_test.ps1` (both fail without the fix). Closes https://github.com/nikolareljin/script-helpers/issues/84.
- **`make test` runs every test file and lists the failures.** It stopped at the first failing file, so every file sorted after it never ran. It now runs all of them, prints `FAILED: <n> of <m> test file(s):` with each failed file, and exits 1; a clean run prints `All <m> test file(s) passed.`. `tests/screencap_test.sh` takes a real screenshot only with `SCREENCAP_TEST_REAL=1`: it ran one whenever a device was attached and failed there, so a developer with a phone plugged in got a red suite. Tests: `tests/make_test_all_test.sh` and `tests/screencap_device_test.sh` (both fail without the fix). Closes https://github.com/nikolareljin/script-helpers/issues/83.
- **ShellCheck findings fail CI.** `ci.yml` ran `xargs shellcheck || true` over `*.sh` only, so a finding never failed a run and `scripts/git-hooks/*`, `bin/*` and `templates/dev-cli/dev` were never checked. CI now runs `make lint-shell` (`scripts/lint_shell.sh`): every tracked `*.sh` file plus every tracked file with a `sh` or `bash` shebang, failing at severity `warning` (`SHELLCHECK_SEVERITY` overrides; an unknown value exits 2). Files with a `dash` or `ksh` shebang are checked too. The 20 existing warnings in `tests/` are fixed: `cd || exit 1` in six tests, `find` instead of `ls | grep` in `dev_service_verbs_test.sh`, an unused local in `lint_docs_test.sh`, and a scoped `SC2034`/`SC2154` disable where a variable is set or read by name. `lint-and-examples` and `powershell` in `ci.yml` and `macos` in `ci-macos.yml` now set `timeout-minutes` (40, 15, 120). Test: `tests/lint_shell_test.sh` (fails without the fix; skips its behaviour checks where shellcheck is absent, as on the bash 3.2 image and macOS).
